root.gloss: to be bright, to shine; sky, heaven

examples.pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
examples.en: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

examples.pie: deywṓm deywós h₁ési.
examples.en: You are the god of the gods.

examples.pie: déywe h₁uséwōm déh₃tor gʰóstis h₁édih₁t. nu pótnih₂ h₁édih₁t tr̥pih₁mé.
examples.en: God, giver of good things, may the guest eat! May the wife eat, may we be sated.

root.gloss: to be bright, to shine; sky, heaven

examples.pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
examples.en: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

examples.pie: dyéw nos ph₂ter pĺ̥th₂ewi méh₂ter ḱlutóm.
examples.en: Father Sky, Mother Broad One, hear us!

examples.pie: kʷís stestóh₂e pótis-kʷe tóm ne h₂eh₂nóḱe? só dyḗws h₁ésti.
examples.en: Who stands, and no ruler has reached him? It is the sky.

root.gloss: to produce; to beget; to give birth

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ ǵénh₁tri gʷṓm h₂mélǵoh₂? ḱóm sddʰí. h₁íh₂m̥ mē Hyowdʰéyes. h₁íh₂m̥ gʰbʰestíbʰis h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. spéḱye. h₂mélǵmi. móḱs h₁éwks. h₁íh₂-ge méwdt.
examples.en: Mother, how shall I milk the cow? Sit down close by. Do not agitate it. Milk it with the hands. Look! I am milking! You have learned quickly. It has indeed become glad.

examples.pie: ǵénh₁tri moy gʷéHye. ḱléwse. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr gʷegʷóme. léwkos nos bʰéreti. nu tód ḱóm gʷéHyōmes. h₂éwsōs diwés dʰugh₂tḗr gʷegʷóme. gʷr̥néHmi te tód h₁éwks.
examples.en: Mother, sing for me! Listen. Dawn, daughter of Sky, has come. She brings light to us. Now let us sing that together! Dawn, daughter of Sky, has come. I praise you: you have learned it.

examples.pie: kʷíd ǵénh₁tri h₁énos upér? só n̥bʰrós móḱs h₂wérseti. h₂ówins dṓm h₁n̥dó wédʰe. h₁íh₂es n̥bʰrṓd dedwiyḗr? h₁ésmōd ne dedwiyḗr h₂yuHn̥ḱéh₂es de studént. nu h₁íh₂n̥s wédʰoh₂.
examples.en: Mother, what is that yonder above? That is a rain-cloud; soon it will rain. Lead the sheep into the house! Are they afraid of the rain? They are not afraid of it, but the young ones get cold. I am leading them now!

pie-lex-gwhedhyeti.gloss: to keep requesting, to keep asking for; to pray (for), plead

examples.pie: h₂éh₂usom moy h₂éti dh₃dʰí h₁yód toy déh₃m̥. wíḱpotey h₁íd h₁áyso. kʷíd h₁íd gʷʰédʰyesi? ne gʰrémes. ḱḗr toy wéydsom. ḱḗr moy te sékʷetor. lm̥bʰdʰí h₂éh₂usom h₂éti ḱód-kʷe péh₃tlom lm̥bʰdʰí. túH h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr.
examples.en: Give me back the gold that I gave you. Take it, lord. Why do you ask for it? You did not become angry. I wanted to see your heart. My heart follows you. Take back the gold, and take this cup. You are a giver of good things.

root.gloss: to wish; to request; to search

examples.pie: séh₂ kundʰtó h₂isḱét-kʷe só tā́m. só tā́m ne ǵnéh₃t.
examples.en: She hid, and he sought her. He did not recognize her.

examples.pie: h₁yós h₁nómn̥ h₂isḱḗti déh₃nom bʰoréyetu.
examples.en: Whoever seeks a name, let him bring a gift.

examples.pie: kʷíd h₂isḱési? h₂isḱóh₂ méne bʰréh₂term̥.
examples.en: What are you seeking? I am seeking my brother.

pie-lex-kjoymos.gloss: homely, belonging to the family, kin

root.gloss: to be lying down; to settle

examples.pie: swēḱurós ḱóymos h₁ésti.
examples.en: The brother-in-law is kin.

examples.pie: h₁ést ǵm̥rós ḱóymos.
examples.en: The son-in-law was kin.

examples.pie: gʷówes m̥rént ḱóymōs m̥rént wiHrós mért. h₁wésu ḱléwos ne mért. h₁yós h₁wésu ḱléwos wéneti h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ gʷíh₃weti. sóh₂wl̥ h₂ew gʷm̥yéti h₁éy h₂ew ne gʷm̥yéti.
examples.en: Cattle die, kin die, a man dies. Good fame does not die. Whoever wins good fame, his name lives. The sun comes again; he does not come again.

examples.pie: dyḗws dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe bʰidn̥tó léwks-kʷe mélh₃t.
examples.en: Sky and Earth split apart, and brightness came forth.

examples.pie: kéh₂nmn̥ moy gʷéHye. h₂uséy diwés dʰugh₂tréy gʷéHyoh₂. h₂éwsos h₂usdʰí léwkm̥-kʷe nos bʰére. tód kéh₂nmn̥ h₁wésu.
examples.en: Sing me a song! I sing to Dawn, the daughter of Sky. Dawn, grow bright, and bring us the light! That song is good.

examples.pie: nu sóh₂wl̥ deywóns h₂nérn̥s-kʷe spéḱyesi. séngʷs-ge h₁regʷesyét-kʷe stéh₂s léwks-kʷe h₁ludʰét. dyḗm nos stéygʰont sóh₂wl̥ h₂lékse.
examples.en: Now, Sun, you look upon the gods and men. You indeed sank, and it grew dark; you stood up, and light came. Sun, climbing the sky, guard us.

pie-lex-lowh3trom.gloss: that which is used for washing:; washbasin, bathtub
senses: that which is used for washing:
that which is used for washing:

examples.pie: méh₂tēr swóm suHnúm h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂s usménh₁ woséyet. h₁éy wésmn̥ wésto. wésmn̥ h₁wésu? h₁íd h₁wésu. nu lówh₃trom dʰwórm̥ wéǵʰet.
examples.en: The mother clothed her son in a garment of wool. He wore the garment. "Is the garment good?" "It is good." Then she carried the washbasin to the door.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ ḱód bʰéh₂mi? mélit dlukú. mélit dlukú. médʰu swéh₂dyos. nu médʰu péh₃oh₂.
examples.en: How do I say this? The honey is sweet. The honey is sweet. And mead is very sweet! Then I shall drink mead.

examples.pie: mélit nos sélpos-kʷe h₁opéye gʷr̥h₃ṓmes-kʷe.
examples.en: Give us honey and fat, and let us eat!

examples.pie: mélit dʰoHnéh₂i dʰédʰeh₁m̥ léyǵʰm̥-kʷe tód.
examples.en: I put honey on the grain, and I licked it.

examples.pie: ḱḗr h₁yód mn̥yétor dn̥ǵʰwéh₂s tód wérh₁yeti. ǵn̥h₃rósyo h₁óh₃s h₁ésyo ḱérdi h₁ésti. h₂egʰósyo ḱḗr h₁ésyo h₁éh₃si h₁ésti.
examples.en: What the heart thinks, the tongue says. The mouth of the wise man is in his heart. The heart of the bad man is in his mouth.

examples.pie: ḱm̥tóm h₁éḱwons dʰǵʰyés widóm. tód h₁sónt? mn̥yóh₂er tód dʰrówgʰos. HeHḱéwes h₁éḱwōs h₂éǵroy dr̥mént. nu méǵh₂h₂ dedórḱth₂e.
examples.en: Yesterday I saw a hundred horses! Is that true? I think: that is a lie. The swift horses ran in the field. Then you have seen great things!

examples.pie: kʷíd mn̥yéth₂er? bʰréh₂term̥ moy mn̥yóh₂er. h₃rēǵés ḱóymom gʷéh₂t h₂ew-kʷe ne gʷegʷóme. móḱs h₂ew gʷm̥yéh₁t. wékʷesbʰos toy bʰebʰóydʰh₂e.
examples.en: What are you thinking of? I am thinking of my brother. He went to the king's village, and he has not come back. May he come back quickly! I trust your words.

pie-lex-srobheyeti.gloss: to be sipping, sucking; to cause to sip, suck

examples.pie: gʷówes sth₂éh₁yete gʷḗn h₂mélǵti. gʷówes dedh₃té wr̥h₁ḗn srobʰéyeti. mē bʰih₂té ḱéywa gʷḗn muddʰí.
examples.en: Stand, cattle, stand, the woman milks. Give, cattle, give, the lamb sips. Do not be afraid! Be joyful, dear woman!

examples.pie: nu wódr̥ mē tr̥syéh₁t srobʰéyōmes-kʷe.
examples.en: Now may the water not dry up, and let us sip!

examples.pie: h₁rósm̥ srobʰéyet ǵnéh₃t-kʷe ǵéwstum.
examples.en: He sipped the liquid, and he came to know the taste.

examples.pie: nu h₂éḱruh₂ méne h₃kʷsú h₁ésti. nu méne suHnús lelóykʷe. wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím ne h₁épt ǵʰoysós h₁ím ne térh₃t. nu kʷis h₁ím sléh₂gʷt h₁ím-kʷe wéydsoh₂. nu-kʷe h₂énǵʰos méne gudóm gʷr̥h₃éti. kʷís méǵʰye h₁ím h₁opéyēti?
examples.en: Tears are in my eyes. My son is gone. The wolf did not seize him, the spear did not wound him. Someone has seized him, and I long to see him. And now grief eats my entrails. Who will give him to me?

pie-lex-gwhentoxr.gloss: one who strikes, kills; slayer, killer

examples.pie: gʷʰéntōr n̥ḱéws dʰugh₂tréy déh₃rom déh₃eti.
examples.en: The killer shall give a gift to the daughter of the dead one.

examples.pie: gʰórdʰe moy gʷṓs kʷsépi ph₂sdʰí. ḱwónes h₁régʷesi bʰéwdʰete. gʷʰéntōr-kʷe stóygʰom mē widóyh₁t. h₁ésyo-kʷe h₁éḱwos h₁ím Hih₁kyéh₁t. pérkʷune h₁ím h₂ḱm̥néh₁ kl̥h₂dʰí. gʷówes moy gʷowsth₂óm wékʷsperoy gʷm̥yóyh₁ent.
examples.en: Fence, guard my cattle at night. Dogs, be awake in the darkness. And may the slayer not find the path. And may his horse throw him. Perkunos, strike him with a stone. May my cows come to the stall in the evening.

pie-lex-h2elgwheti.gloss: to be worth, cost; to deserve

root.gloss: to cost, have value, be worth

forms.g: to be worth, have value; to cost

examples.pie: wr̥h₁dʰí moy kʷíd h₁éḱwos h₂élgʷʰeti? h₁wésus h₁éḱwos déḱm̥ ugʷsénn̥s h₂élgʷʰeti. kʷíd pṓlHos h₂élgʷʰeti? pṓlHos pénkʷe h₂egʷnóns h₂élgʷʰeti.
examples.en: Tell me, what is a horse worth? A good horse is worth ten oxen. What is a foal worth? A foal is worth five lambs.

examples.pie: uksénes moy gʷr̥déwes. h₂eḱróm ḱéntrom wéḱmi. h₁íd h₂éyesos tétḱoh₂ ḱr̥h₂nṓd-wē tétḱoh₂? ḱr̥h₂nṓd. h₂éyos polh₁ú h₂élgʷʰeti. h₁l̥ḱéys moy ḱr̥h₂nóm widé. ne gʰrémōnti? gʰrémōnti. HéHḱyos stéygʰōnti.
examples.en: My oxen are slow. I want a sharp pointed tool. Shall I make it from bronze or from horn? From horn. Bronze costs much. Find me the horn of an elk. Will they not become angry? They will become angry. They will walk more swiftly.

examples.pie: kʷíh₁ h₁wésum kʷérom ǵn̥néh₃oh₂? h₁ím toy ǵʰóstoh₁ kl̥h₂dʰí. kéh₂ilos kʷéros kh₂néti. bʰidtós th₂kéh₁yeti. ḱós kh₂néti. só moy h₁wésistos. káprom h₂élgʷʰeti. nu h₂élyom kélh₂oh₂. h₁ím ml̥dú kl̥h₂dʰí. h₁ím mē Hréwps.
examples.en: How shall I know a good pot? Strike it with your hand. A whole pot sings. A split one keeps silent. This one sings! That is my best one. It costs a goat. Then I will strike another one. Strike it gently! Do not break it!

examples.pie: príHe kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. gʷŕ̥Hte gʰóstey. kʷís túH? h₁eǵóh₂ kʷértrom. h₁eǵóh₂ werdʰokʷr̥tḗr.
examples.en: Friend, be well! Welcome, guest! Who are you? I am a machine. I am a word-maker.

examples.pie: dʰwórm̥ toy gʷegʷómh₂e. gʷŕ̥Hte gʰóstey. méh₃yesi. h₁ddʰí ph₃dʰí-kʷe. túH moy ḱéywos. túH deywóybʰos keh₂rós.
examples.en: I have come to your door. Welcome, guest! You are getting tired. Eat and drink! You are friendly to me. You are dear to the gods.

examples.pie: ḱóymom toy gʷegʷómh₂e. gʷŕ̥Hte gʰóstey. ḱḗr moy méwdt. ph₂wéni h₁épi sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe. príHe moy túH keh₂rós.
examples.en: I have come to your home. Welcome, guest! My heart has grown glad. Sit at the fire and eat! Friend, you are dear to me.
